title: [Audit] Cross-space Kibana activity
description: Which identities work in which Kibana spaces, all Kibana traffic, one row per identity. Identities in more than one space are the ones worth understanding. Spaces appear by id (the /s/<id> in the URL).
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE kibana.space.id IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY kibana.space.id, user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | STATS events = SUM(n), spaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.space.id), space_list = VALUES(kibana.space.id) BY actor | SORT spaces DESC, events DESC | EVAL space_list = REPLACE(MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(space_list), ", "), "-", "-⁠") | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME actor AS Identity, spaces AS Spaces, space_list AS `Space list`, events AS Events
